articleTitle: Broadband microstrip filter
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: In this paper presented is the design of microstrip filter having fractional bandwidth up to 100% and being stable against heightened levels of power.

articleTitle: The single-strip line is a new type of the integrated circuits for microwaves
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The analysis of single-strip line are presented. The considered line consists of a conductor of some width, being placed on a dielectric substrate. The problem was solved using the integral operator half-inversion method. A dispersion equation was obtained for surface waves in a line. The calculations of dispersion relations and current density distribution on the strip line conductor were given.

articleTitle: Solid-state components for advanced MM and subMM (26.5...300 GHz) radio-electronic equipment
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The authors present millimeter (MM) and submillimeter (subMM) wave solid-state devices and components developed at State Enterprise RI "Orion", Kiev, which are intended to be used in promising radio-electronic equipment of wide application and dual purpose.

articleTitle: Three channel receive-converting modules
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: A series of narrowband receive-converting modules providing gain of 30 dB at noise figure of 2.7-4.0 dB in the frequency ranges of 8.0-8.3, 10.0-10.3, 14.0-14.3, 17.0-17.3 GHz, has been designed and tested.

articleTitle: Silicon IMPATT diodes of improved reliability
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: We present the results of our investigation of silicon double-drift diodes intended for the millimeter wavelength range. Their ohmic contacts to the n/sup +/-area were based on the Pd/sub 2/Si-Ti-Pd-Au metallization, while those to the p/sup +/-area were based on the Pd/sub 2/Si-TiN-Ti-Au metallization. The accelerated tests of these IMPATT diodes at T=335, 346 and 375/spl deg/C have shown that the activation energy of degradation processes was 2.03 eV. An analysis of the diodes after failure has shown that no parametric failures occurred; the only mechanism for failures was metal penetration through the mesa.

articleTitle: Investigation of microstrip antennas covered with two dielectric layers
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The influence of a two-layer cover on the microstrip antenna parameters is considered. The effects of impedance matching and filtering are investigated for half wavelength and quarter wavelength layers.

articleTitle: Investigation of intertype oscillations in the barrel-shaped open resonator
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The results of experimental investigation and theoretical analysis of interaction processes of different type of oscillations in the Barrel-Shaped Open Resonators (BORs) are presented. All experiments were made in four-millimeter wave range. We used mechanically retunable BOR designing with a longitudinally narrow slot. In result a frequency ranges for interacting modes TEM and TE were defined and a behavior of Q-factor of modes was studied in range of interaction.

articleTitle: Experimental sets for process monitoring of water-oil emulsion decomposition during microwave heating
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The question of experimental set construction for research of water-oil emulsion decomposition processes under influence of microwave electromagnetic field are considered. Metrological characteristics of sets are given and the prospects of application are determined.

articleTitle: An approximation of statistical characteristics of the modified gun of DRG band-like current
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: A numerical treatment is carried out for the experimental results of investigation of a modified electron gun that has been proposed and utilized in microwave electronics devices. The analytical formulas for high accuracy calculation of the statistical pulsing of an electron current boundary of this gun are obtained.

articleTitle: 162-241 GHz heterodyne spectrometer for solar and ecological studies
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The features of the functional scheme and design of a heterodyne radiometer for studies of spectral singularities of solar radiation, Earth atmosphere and other sources are described briefly in this report.

articleTitle: Problems of mathematical modeling in adaptive systems for integrated telecommunication networks control
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Summary form only given. Application of the decomposition approach to the modelling of adaptive control systems of telecommunication networks is considered. Application of spectral numerical algorithms of exponent decreasing at the increasing of dimensional representation of the researched mathematical models is necessary.

articleTitle: Microwave technological complexes design in view of power consumption factor
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The purpose of microwave treatment is the realization of electromagnetic action on the handled object. The indispensable values of vector of actions are be found as ensuring permissible variations of output properties. The problem of development of devices of the microwave appendices consists of a choice of requirements, for which the aggregate quality appears at minimum consumption of microwave energy. The new effectiveness criterion of a manufacturing process of microwave treatment based on minimization of expenditure of microwave energy is offered. Usage of the given measure allows one to realize a choice of modes of microwave processing aggregate rates of flux, ensuring a drop, on realization of a manufacturing process with usage of microwave electromagnetic energy. For realization of calculations according to offered criteria of reduced microwave power consumption, the assay technique is offered and the values of weighting coefficients which take into account dependence of the rates of flux on realization of different modes of microwave processing depending on frequency band, aggregate power and parameters of modulation evaluated.

articleTitle: Automobile brake system monitoring device based on EHF autodyne generators
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The results of research and development of the test sample of a radio-wave device for vehicle movement parameters monitoring are summarized in this report. The device has been designed for the quick and precise control of a vehicle brake system in stationary (at car repair stations, automobile factories) as well as in road conditions. The autonomous device consists of a portable receiving-transmitting three-beam monounit, brake pedal pressure sensor and a central unit, The radar monounit is based on the autodyne receiving-transmitting modules which are connected with three antennas. Each of the antennas has a 60/spl deg/-slope to the underlying surface and the second antenna is turned by 35/spl deg/ from the plane passing through the first and the third antennas. The aperture diameter of each antenna is 50 mm. The device is used as follows: the pressure sensor is fastened to a brake pedal, the three-beam autodyne radio-locator monounit is hitched to the side surface of the vehicle body by means of a magnetic system.

articleTitle: Multifrequency operation modes of traveling wave tube with helix slowing system
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The mathematical model of traveling wave tube with helix slowing system is formulated at excitation of any number of amplified waves not taking into account the losses. The dispersion of phase speed and the couple impedance are designed on the basis of model of the helix-conducting cylinder.

articleTitle: Application of the finite delta-source for solving of Poclington's equation
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: For numerical calculation of a full current of wire antennas the use of finite delta-source is offered. The source produces the constant tangent component of electric intensity vector near to the excitation point and does not produce extraneous field in the remaining space of antenna.

articleTitle: Simulation of dendrite fractal antennas
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Input characteristics of printed fractal antenna of dendrite type were simulated using the method of equivalent R-L-C circuits, whose topology is corresponds to the topology of the antenna. The results of simulation demonstrate good agreement with experimental data.

articleTitle: Method of synthesis of optimum linear codes, correcting and discovering errors in systems of communication
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: A method and algorithm of construction of linear codes for correction and detection of a number of independent errors is suggested. The parameters of the synthesised codes coincide with the parameters of the well-known codes, but the proposed specific method of code construction allows obtaining other optimum codes for any set of errors.

articleTitle: Application of beam triodes with bipotential cathode in the tube generator modes
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The results of the comparative analysis of the electrical parameters of generator triodes and modulator triode with bipotential cathode are presented.

articleTitle: Use of a VSWR meter in problems of propagation constants measurement
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The possibility of measurement of wave propagation constant of completely and partly filled waveguides is shown by means of complex dielectric permeability. Corresponding measurement methods are considered.

articleTitle: 2.4 GHz radio equipment, produced at Novopolotsk Factory "Izmeritel"
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)

articleTitle: Frequency opportunities of GaAs MDS-structures
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: MDS-structures based on GaAs and carbon diamond-like films (CDLF) are experimentally investigated. Voltage-current and voltage-capacity characteristics are measured. The frequency band of such structures is calculated.

articleTitle: Spectral examination of the "loading" effect while removing the photoresist coatings from the substrate surfaces in the microwave plasma discharge
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The experimental results of examination of optical emission of a microwave plasma discharge in oxygen, performed in order to determine the spectral lines, specific to the process of the plasma chemical removal of the photoresist masks, are presented. It is determined, that due to the specific manifestation of the "loading" effect when processing the silicon substrates in the microwave plasma discharge, the control of process of photoresist removing from small batches of substrates is expedient to be carried out by controlling the intensity of the strip CO (/spl lambda/=519.82 nm). In the case of processing the large quantity of substrates the control should be carried out by the line O I (/spl lambda/=777.7 nm; /spl lambda/=844.6 nm).

articleTitle: Frequency demodulators, optimized for image signals reception
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The results of research of FM signal spectrum using analytical methods, are submitted. The block diagram of the demodulator optimized for image signal reception is offered.

articleTitle: The development results of the microwave-based device for defect exposure in multi-layer fiberglass plastic structures, polymer and lacquer-and-paint coatings
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Presents the development results of a device for defect exposure in flaky multi-layer fiber-glass plastic structures (e.g. airborne radomes) and polymeric and lacquer-and-paint protective coatings. A defects disclosure criterion is based on the analysis of amplitude and phase parameters of incident and reflected waves with the use of special algorithm in non-defect and defective materials. The range of working frequencies is 53...62 GHz. The device consists of two blocks: SHF sensor and microprocessor unit with LCD-indicator. Power supply: 220 V, 50 Gz (or 22...32 V DC), 8 W.

articleTitle: The use of multielement excitation for the improvement of microwave energy distribution uniformity in a partly filled microwave chamber
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The subject studied is the problem of improvement of microwave energy distribution uniformity. The using of multi-element excitation of rectangular microwave chambers is proposed. The distribution calculations were carried out by means of the exhaustive method from the limited number of variants. Multi-element excitation allows the significant improvement of microwave energy distribution uniformity inside the material.

articleTitle: Direction characteristics of short-pulse antennas
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Direction characteristics of short-pulse antennas are considered, using Fourier transform. Radiation patterns and directivity factor (DF) of short-pulse antennas with uniform amplitude distribution are presented for diverse aperture antennas (linear, planar and array antennas) and the most widely used pulses (rectangular, Gaussian, bipolar and sine). The directivity factor of such antennas is shown as a function of the pulse shape and relative aperture dimension.

articleTitle: Investigation of patterns of antenna arrays with circular polarization
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The derivation of the correlations for calculation of pattern of antenna arrays or sub-arrays with ring-like arrangement of elements is shown. The example of the calculation of pattern and ellipticity factor of ring-like antenna array with symmetrical vibrators over the conducting screen having twelve branches, being fed with the progressive phase shift is considered. It is shown that along the axis of array circular polarization is provided, and patterns and ellipticity factor of array in planes, perpendicular to axis of array with different location angles are isotropic.

articleTitle: PLLFC application in the system of Doppler's shifts of received signals
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The results of the theoretical investigation of the possibility of widening the spectral band of the Doppler shift of received signals relative to the lock-in range of a phase-locked-loop frequency control (PLLFC) system are presented. This provides the possibility of using synchronous demodulation in the system with Doppler shift of the received signal.

articleTitle: Efficiency of peniotron at high harmonics
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The comparative research of an overall performance of the peniotron-generator and peniotron-amplifier on various harmonics of cyclotron frequency is carried out. The limit efficiency in a range of harmonics from 4-th up to 20-th is determined.

articleTitle: Automated system for multifrequency measurement of the far field pattern
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The description of the automated stand for measurements of multi-frequency far-field antenna pattern is given. The stand is based on standard microwave instrumentation and modern computing methods. The stand can realize pattern measurement at 200 frequencies simultaneously for one rotational displacement of the tested antenna with a speed up to 5 angular points per second.

articleTitle: Investigation of artillery shell motion features at the initial stage of a shot using radar methods
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Described in this work are the results of experimental research on the peculiarities of artillery shell motion, carried out with the use of SHF-range continuous radiation radars.

articleTitle: Small-sized microwave module for radiospectrometers of new generation
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The microwave module for radio spectrometers of the new generation is presented. The distinctive features of this device are small-size and small-power performance and manufacturability while retaining and increasing the main technical characteristics. It is achieved due to use of recent advances in microwave semiconductor microelectronics.

articleTitle: The research of microwave amplifier amplitude and phase noise using nonlinear CAD software
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: In the present article the research results of amplitude and phase noise of amplifiers with GaAs transistors with a Schottky barrier are submitted. Their dependence on input signal level and physical properties of a field-effect transistor (breakdown voltages and gate widths) is shown. The research results allow one to forecast behavior of amplitude and phase noise of amplifiers, not resorting to labour-consuming measurements, to optimize structure of radar transmitters depending on specificity of their usage in a different range of Doppler signals.

articleTitle: Effect of purity of the starting materials on the parameters of epitaxial GaAs, produced by MOCVD-method
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: High-purity arsine and trimethylgallium are used to produce A/sup 3/B/sup 5/ epitaxial layers by MOCVD-method for application in microwave devices and in optoelectronics. The present work is aimed to investigate the effect of purity of the starting materials on the electrophysical parameters of epitaxial gallium arsenide, produced by MOCVD-method, as well as to develop the technology for the production of high-purity arsine and TMG.

articleTitle: Application of CVD-diamond substrates for microwave semiconductor devices
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: This paper presents results of development of hybrid integrated circuits, microwave IMPATT-diodes using CVD diamond substrates. The thermal analysis of microwave devices design is carried out. Test results are presented.

articleTitle: Panel antennas for remote user terminals of GSM-1800 cellular network
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: High antenna gain, construction simplicity, transportation comfort and comparatively low cost are the main advantages of the developed panel antennas. They can be used for increasing user terminal operating range within the cellular network GSM-1800.

articleTitle: Single-crystal optical fibers of infrared band
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The results of experimental investigations on deriving single-crystal light guides of an infrared range are given.

articleTitle: About influence of the cavity system production errors on reproduction of magnetron parameters
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The difficulties in stabilization of magnetron parameters sharply increase with the operating wave length decreasing. The real magnetron resonator system of a millimeter band is not possible to be considered as a uniform system because of processing non-uniformities influence. This work is aimed to develop methods for calculated estimation of the influence of resonator system production errors on the reproduction of magnetron parameters.

articleTitle: Processing section of the ESR spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The description of digital processing and filtering section of an EPR spectrometer is given. Some of functional blocks of measuring section are fabricated at the software level. There is opportunity of active variation of the digital filter parameters.

articleTitle: The selection of signal phase modulation component in retransmission measurers
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: This report presents the results of research on signal phase modulation component selection in a retransmission meter, operating in the mode of continuous radiation with FM and used for the remote control of technological process parameters. The proportions of signal spectral components under the condition of partial suppression of parasitic spectral components have been calculated. The method of selection of information about distance described here allows one to compensate for the harmful influence of spectrum parasitic components generated by the retransmitter.

articleTitle: Broadband medium power amplifier
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The results of research on a GaAs MMIC broadband medium power amplifier based on a MESFET process are presented. The calculated properties of the amplifier over the frequency band 1-8 GHz are given.

articleTitle: Unification of the requirements to parameters of semi-manufactures in designing of multivariant products
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Frequently the different customers formulate different technical requirements (TR) to the same product. So the nomenclature groups of products are formed. Such products are named as "multivariant products". In designing there is the necessity to solve the inverse problem: to determine the unified requirements to parameters of semi-manufactures (tolerances) in dependence upon the requirements to the output characteristics of the product.

articleTitle: Distortion of acoustic pulses shape in acousto-optical device
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Distortion of acoustic pulse shape excited by acoustooptical cell's (AOC) piezotransducer is considered. Evaluation of the pulses rise time is carried out for acoustooptical shutter. Numerical results calculated for LiNbO/sub 3/-In-Cu-In-SiO/sub 2/-structure are presented.

articleTitle: Tuneable microstrip scatterer
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: New class of controlled reflective type antenna arrays is considered. These arrays are executed as integrated chips. The proposed structures are a kind of microstrip diffraction arrays. The microstrip radiators may have an arbitrary shape. Each radiator contains controlled elements (crystal diodes). Changing the diodes' bias voltages varies the array electromagnetic characteristics. This digital diffraction array has a set of microwave radar images. Such arrays are capable of being applied to a radar-tracking environment.

articleTitle: The multiple-beam diffraction radiation tubes-sources of millimetre and sub-millimetre waves
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: In the report, the results of an investigation of diffraction radiation tubes with spatially-developed multiple-beam electron flows are presented.

articleTitle: The problem of parameters definition for troposphere waveguides
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The simple relations for calculation of critical frequencies and "feeding" angles of troposphere waveguides (TW), are presented. The paper points out that the radio-waves refraction index changes abruptly near to sea/dry land boundary. This change may lead to generation of corroborated waveguide distribution along the Black Sea shore.

articleTitle: Radiometric device for the measurement of absorption of low-intensity continuous spectrum UHF-signals [by human skin]
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: A high-sensitivity radiometric measuring system (HRMS) for the measurement of low-level UHF-signal absorption is described in this report. The HRMS allows one to determine the dependence of absorption level of various objects on the radiating source power (temperature).

articleTitle: Power characteristics of the class E amplifier on the bipolar transistor
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The results of a numerical simulation based on the bipolar transistor first-order model of the class-E amplifier with a common emitter and low power dissipation on the collector, are presented.

articleTitle: Gunn diode oscillators for telecommunication system with direct frequency modulation
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Low FM and AM noise Gunn diode oscillators with operating frequencies from 10 to 37.5 GHz have been designed, produced and tested. The opportunity of linear tuning in the frequency range from 150 to 500 MHz realized with varactors makes it possible to use Gunn diode oscillators in FM transmitters.

articleTitle: Tunable acoustic-electronic cryotron
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Results of YBa/sub 2/Cu/sub 3/O/sub 7/ tunable acoustic-electronic cryotron elaboration are presented. The specific switching time depends on surface acoustic wave (SAW) frequency, number of contacts and their configuration.

articleTitle: Fiber-optical transceiver for analog microwave systems of information transfer
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Fiber-optic single-mode transmitter and photodetector for high frequency (7.5-9.5 GHz) analog or high-bit-rate digital optical links was designed as alternative device for standard coaxial or waveguide microwave telecommunication equipment. The transmitter is based on high-frequency 1.3 /spl mu/m laser diode with low parasitic capacitance construction, the photodetector is based on high-speed 40 /spl mu/m (dia) InP/InGaAs PIN photodiode. Low-noise operation of optical link "transmitter-photodetector" was demonstrated without optical isolators due to original low back-reflection construction of photo-detector and FC/APC pigtail connectors. The electrical output/input transmission ratio was reached (-28...-32) dB, RIN=(-135...-145) dB/Hz, frequency band may be widened up to 10.5 GHz.

articleTitle: Experience of design of millimeter-wave phased array microstrip patch antenna based on ferroelectric phase shifters
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: In this paper the results of theoretical and experimental research of a microstrip phased array for the range 28-30 GHz, with phase shifters, implemented on the basis of ferroelectric films, are given. Two designs of millimeter-wave phased array antennas based on ferroelectric phase shifters are described. The first version has 16 elements and four phase shifters with narrow sector of scanning (/spl plusmn/20 degree from normal direction). The second version is a one-dimensional scanning antenna for an LMDS system with a gain of about 22 dB. The pattern has a special form in the E-plane and pencil form in the plane of scanning.

articleTitle: Power distributions for short dipole antennas at the short distance
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Based on a strict solution of the problem of thin wire antenna radiation, the spatial distribution of vector components and electromagnetic field power has been investigated. It has been shown that the radiation theory, worked out for a Hertz dipole, is applicable for wire antennas with length up to 0.02 /spl lambda/. Such antennas have a far zone distance of 0.5 /spl lambda/.

articleTitle: Generation of axial non-uniform waves by layer of electrons rotating in the free space
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Axial non-uniform electromagnetic waves generation by electrons, rotating in crossed fields in the free space (in the absence of the resonator) is investigated theoretically. It is shown that at the condition of Cherenkov resonance under sufficiently great radial electrostatic field, the generated wave increment grows with frequency increasing. That is why strong radial electrostatic fields can influence the increasing of wave frequencies, generated in similar systems.

articleTitle: MM-wave range magnetrons. Modern state and perspectives of development
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Despite the fact that during the 1990's the number of new types of serially produced magnetrons was on a steady decrease, their parameters have been appreciably improved. The analysis of the parameters of pulse and continuous MM-wave magnetrons which have been designed and developed in Russia, Ukraine, Great Britain and the USA shows the advantages of magnetrons operating in a non /spl pi/-type mode.

articleTitle: Web-catalog of microwave electronics
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: For the first time a Web-catalog of microwave electronics has been created with IATP international program support. The catalog is distinguished by a combination of both a database on the devices produced by the Russian and worldwide industries, and the data concerning the new microwave electronic devices development in the frequency bands of 3-300 GHz.

articleTitle: Investigation of phase section based on coupled microstrip lines
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: In quasi-static approximation, the frequency response (FR) and group delay time variation (/spl Delta/GDT) behaviour dependencies were studied in the pass band of section based on the coupled micro-strip lines, from its constructive parameters. A good theory/experiment agreement was obtained.

articleTitle: A microwave meter for small distances
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: A microwave-based device for the measurement of small distances on the basis of phase radar methods is presented in this report. These methods provide a sufficient increase in distance measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: The integral-methodology method of position finding of radio-frequency radiation sources
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: A method of radio-frequency radiation source position finding, representing a combination of direction finding, hyperbolic and combined direction finding and hyperbolic methods with integral processing of the surplus information about the position of the source is described.

articleTitle: High stability Gunn oscillator for the global interferometry application
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The paper presents the design of high stability low noise Gunn diode oscillator with small frequency tuning by varactor. It is intended to be used especially as a local oscillator in the radiointerferometer of radiotelescope RT-22 (Crimean Radioastrophysical Observatory CRO).

articleTitle: Equivalent one-dimensional model of electron beam in relativistic klystrons
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The equivalent one-dimensional model of a relativistic electron beam is presented; the obtained expression for correction factors permits one to realize a transition from a two-dimensional model to a equivalent one-dimensional model.

articleTitle: Selective suppression of linear arrays pattern side-lobes
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: A method for the suppression of pattern side-lobes of linear equidistant arrays, located in a partial deviation from the given amplitude distribution on separate elements of array, is explained. The results of mathematical simulation of the given method application, are given.

articleTitle: Design of electromagnetic compatible systems with crossed-field
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The constant and varying conditions, influencing the operation of crossed-field systems have been described. The evaluation of their influence on the output parameters of M-type devices has been presented.

articleTitle: Communication systems using the spread time signals
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The determination of spread time signals is given. The formation principles of the ST-signals are discussed. The possibility of information transfer by systems using such signals is shown. Spread time signals classification is presented.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic simulation of a wireless power transmission system with phased antenna array
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The power transfer efficiency between a transmitting antenna array and receiving rectenna with a continuous circular aperture is considered. The ratio of received and input powers gives the WPT efficiency in dependence of the amplitude distribution in transmitting array The presented data gives a comprehensive description of the basic properties of the microwave WPT system. The gaps between transmitting antenna array elements are increasing the total size of the antenna aperture. It narrows down the angular field distribution in the rectenna and is favorable to the WPT efficiency rise (at values not more than 0.7-0.8). The excessive increasing of gaps increases the side-lobes of the transmitting array. The power inside the main lobe of the angular field distribution decreases and WPT efficiency rising comes down. The first pre-cited tendency is dominated for elements with size </spl lambda/ and increasing of the WPT efficiency is up to tens percent at the optimum gap value. The two pre-cited tendencies are compensate each other with an increase of the element aperture of more than /spl lambda/. The non-uniform (quasi-Gauss) aperture distributions in the transmitting arrays are preferable only at high values WPT efficiency (more than 0.8-0.9). Uniform amplitude distribution is preferable only at the smaller WPT efficiency values (less than 0.8).

articleTitle: About resonant modes at the shielded dielectric hemisphere
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)

articleTitle: Imitating-statistical model of NSAU's corporate data network
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: An aggregate model of NSAU's corporate data network (CDN) is proposed considering operation of management system (MS) in nodes of the network. Using an aggregative approach, an imitating-statistical model of the CDN is offered. The considered imitating-statistical packet CDN model allows to make an efficiency appraisal of determined method of dynamic management by redistribution of packet streams. A method of sequential analysis of network processes provides a possibility of simulating the model realization process using a computer. The dimensions of the designed network are limited in the main by real model time. The modeling results show that at the given simulation accuracy the introduction of dynamic control of packets redistribution reduces packet losses more than on an exponent.

publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)

articleTitle: Experimental study of three-section BSF based on rejection irises
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)

articleTitle: T-shaped branching rectangular waveguides with a ferrite parallelepiped
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The paper presents the results of the research of the H/sub p0/ wave scattering on a T-shaped branching of rectangular waveguides with a transversely magnetized ferrite parallelepiped (FP). The analysis is based on the rigorous solution of the diffraction problem, obtained by the partial regions method with singling out the coupling region through conditions of biorthogonality of eigen functions for transmission lines with gyrotropic filling. The approximate solution in the analytical form is obtained and its accuracy is established.

articleTitle: A new method of EHF-therapy in the treatment of endogene mental diseases
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)

articleTitle: Polarization control technique for flat spiral antennas
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)

articleTitle: Influence of high-power EM-videopulse on insulated cells
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The influence of a short high-power electromagnetic videopulse on a suspension of hepatic cells of 9-weeks human embryo has been investigated. Such pulse was generated by an electron beam of the accelerator "Temp-A" with energy 0.6 MeV, current 4 kA, and time duration 40 nsec falling to rod antenna of 3 m length. The output power was 100 MW. The samples were placed perpendicular to the antenna at 30 cm distance from its center. The free-radical state in the system "hepatocite+hypochlorite" has been investigated using the quantum-metrical set with photo-electronic amplifier FEU-140 in a thermostat box at 37/spl deg/C. The appearance of radical fragments in this system was registered by means of 630 nm spectral line of generated single oxygen. The estimation of the cell viability before and after irradiation was performed using the method of supravital staining by methylene dark blue. It was shown that the influence of video-pulse treatment decreases the percentage of the viability of the hepatocites and activates the free-radical processes and correspondingly enhances the single oxygen generation. The dependence of these processes on the video-pulse power was determined.

articleTitle: Planar R/spl tau/ grid for the analysis of of electromagnetic wave scattering in structures with any distribution of permittivity

articleTitle: The ultra-low absorption investigation in dielectrics and atmosphere within 45-200 GHz frequency band

It was found that Si and diamond output windows for the megawatt microwave gyrotrons have the essential absorption in thin, /spl Lt//spl lambda/, surface layer, leading to surface discharges. Practically all rolled film materials have the distinct anisotropy of dielectric parameters, which also depend upon the producer. The results of atmospheric absorption measurement have been compared with theoretical models.

articleTitle: Excitation peculiarity and frequency characteristics of spiral structures located on sphere-cylinder surface
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: In recent years more and more attention is given to elliptic polarization antennas for mobile terrestrial and space communications. A basic requirement of such antennas is obtaining a high value of polarization ellipticity in a wide sector of radiation angles. Spiral antennas located on a cylindrical surface allow one to obtain relatively high value of directive gain, however polarization ellipticity falls fast while deviating from the axis direction. On the other hand spherical structures have a high value of polarization ellipticity in a wide sector of radiation angles, but they are near-omnidirectional. A spiral antenna located on a sphere-cylinder surface is presented. It enables one to vary between directive gain and polarization ellipticity, obtaining the required relation.

articleTitle: The destruction of asphaltic-paraffin plugs in oil lines by means of a moving source of HF-radiation
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: A new method of eliminating asphaltic-paraffin plugs in oil pipelines by means of a moving source of electromagnetic radiation (so-called "electromagnetic pig") is proposed. The "electromagnetic pig" melts a plug by means of a thermal flux, which is generated by the electromagnetic radiation absorption. To provide an efficient melting of the dielectric plug, the "pig" moves along the tube, following the boundary of the solid and liquid phases. The elimination time of the paraffin plug and its dependence on the frequency has been calculated in the model problem. The estimates of efficiency have been made for the proposed method.

articleTitle: The use of microwave energy for obtaining dry silica sol
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Presented in this work is an original technique of obtaining high-concentration silica sols which are widely used in various branches of industry. This technique consists of three stages: synthesis, stabilization and drying of the silica sols. Microwave evaporation was used at the stage of final drying and removed the local hot spots of the drying substance, thus helping to avoid the formation of a non-reversible gel. The silica sol was dehydrated till 60% concentration and then placed in the chamber of a teflon reactor. The experiment was carried out at one of the industrial frequencies. The uninterrupted mode of generation was used. Silica sol obtained in this way is 100% reversible, e.g. its dry powder disperses in water to a 100% extent, forming an initial colloidal solution.

publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)

articleTitle: Research and optimization of the axial-symmetric multistage depressed collectors

articleTitle: Measuring of average temperature of objects by a radiometric method
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The purpose of the present paper is the solution of key problems, dealing with realization of radiometric measurements of object average temperature. The intensity of a natural thermal radiation of a body depends on its physical properties. The measured values are defined by brightness temperature of object, radiation background and fluctuation component. They estimate the average value of temperature. The task of average temperature measurement is the choice of such measurement conditions and such data processing, for which the derivation of the measured value of brightness temperature from the average value is minimal. The paper presents the choice of antenna and frequency range parameters, at which the resulting error of measuring is minimal. The solution of the indicated problem requires the solution of a number of fundamental issues, dealing with a choice of measuring conditions and processing methods. The conditions, when the aggregate error is minimum have been determined. For a cylindrical model the solutions using experimental data of electrodynamical-similar model, have been obtained. The data show the possibility of conducting enough accurate measurements.

articleTitle: Computer optimization of field sources amplitude distribution in plane cophasal antenna arrays
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Requirements of providing the maximum gain, spatial resolution and minimum side lobe levels of antennas are contradictory. Therefore the problem of antenna optimization by its integral characteristics arises. The integral characteristic describing the side and back radiation is the antenna scattering coefficient. The scattering coefficient determines the noise temperature. In this paper the authors discuss the computer optimization of cophasal antenna arrays.

articleTitle: Radiation of slot antennas in a plane waveguide
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Slot antennas hold a special position in antenna theory and engineering. Presently, the radiation problems of such antennas and calculation of their characteristics using different exact and approximate methods are of considerable interest. In this paper, radiation of longitudinal and transversal slot antennas placed on a perfectly conducting circular cylinder in a plane waveguide with perfectly conducting walls are considered. The problem is solved in the approximation of a thin slot and at the given distribution of the electric field along the slots. Solution of the problem for electromagnetic fields, radiation power and conductivity are presented in the form of a double series over the eigenfunctions of the perfect plane waveguide and the azimuth eigenfunctions of the cylinder. Such a representation is very convenient for numerical calculations. The numerical calculations of real and imaginary parts of the radiation conductivity are performed. The effect of geometrical slot, cylinder and waveguide parameters on the slot antenna characteristics is analyzed. It is mentioned that the radiation characteristics of antennas placed in free space and inside the waveguide are different.

articleTitle: The results of modeling of video pulses scattering by ground structures with continuous law of humidity variation
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Modeling and analysis of video pulse scattering by natural multi-component aeration zones with thicknesses from 1.5 to 5.5 meters have been carried out. It is shown that water presence can be determined only by a reflection from a capillary band in the region contiguous with the water. One has to take into account this result for more exact determination of a depth of water occurrence in the ground. It is established that the pulse observed acquires a duration above a source pulse. The calculation results have shown that errors of measurements of frequency dependencies of permittivities and specific conductivities that are used as initial data then manifest calculation of the diffraction fields for structures of the large depth (that are more than 2-3 meters). In fact this error brines into existence a "false reflection" anteceding to reflections from a capillary band and water. As it is known, this constraint is established after the Kramers-Kronig relations. On this base the conclusion about the necessity of the refinement of source experimental data, is made in parallel instances.

articleTitle: ClearCase-source code managing system
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)

It is provided with the latest achievements in the field of SCM. As ClearCase is the system of corporative level, one can recommend it to all the enterprises, whose designers' number exceeds 5. The software is capable of showing its full advantages only when used in large enterprises with a great number of designers. publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)

articleTitle: Hyperhigh-frequency laser
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)

articleTitle: Analyser of radar signals based on acousto-optic deflector
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The results of development of a pulse analyser for systems of detection and identification of radiofrequency radiation sources are presented. The measurement of signal parameters is based on the complex analysis of signal temporal sample and two sequences of spectrograms with different resolution. The base element of the spectrogram shaper is an acousto-optical deflector. The analyser measures temporal, frequency parameters and pulse modulation parameters of the signal and stores the results in a specified data log. The basic properties of the analyser are given.

articleTitle: Integration of the telecommunication services in wireless networks based on wide band signals

articleTitle: The modern state and perspectives for development of MITRIS system
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: This report presents the generalized characteristics of microwave system developed on a basis of ecologically safe technologies, MITRIS, and condition of its introduction. The directions of MITRIS system development are given. The developed system MITRIS is the basis of ecologically safe wireless networks of integrated service on the basis of a rational combination of opportunities of microwave and cable distribution technologies. The feature of such networks is the opportunity of granting the following telecommunication services complex on their basis: multichannel analog and/or digital, including interactive TV; data transfer and information service (including Internet access); digital telephony; telemedicine and remote training; electronic payments and trade; security and fire-prevention alarm; scheduling of the building engineering equipment; organization of local networks of data transfer for administrative organs and organs of local self-management, education and science organizations, industrial enterprises, etc.; circular notification, including interests of power structures; structure of full scale system, as a rule, includes the following complexes: structure of central station: tele-port for reception of satellite and radio TV programs, TV and radio equipment, radio-relay stations of the selected directions, station for Internet reception, equipment for telephone and computer networks linking, system of coding and calculation of the subscribers, system of the guaranteed power supply, modem equipment, multi-channel microwave transceiver with the device of frequency channel unification, antenna with the circular pattern in horizontal plane. Users' receiving stations (transceivers, providing interactive mode, when necessary), including antenna, receiving converter (transmitter) and tuner, retranslators of signals from the central station to users.

articleTitle: Investigation of the single-electron transistors based on aluminum and its oxides
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)

articleTitle: Plane wave scattering by slots on a ground plane
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The problem is formulated in the following statement. The unlimited space is divided by the indefinitely thin perfect conducting screen into two areas V/sub 1/ and V/sub 2/ (Fig. 1). The area V/sub 1/ with parameters /spl epsiv//sub 1/, /spl mu//sub 1/ contains stimulating sources, located in volume Vj. Area V/sub 2/ with parameters /spl epsiv//sub 2/, /spl mu//sub 2/ does not have stimulating sources. The area V/sub 1/ borrows the whole top half-space and is limited by a surface S/sub 1/, the area V/sub 2/-limited by a surface S/sub 2/. The areas are connected by two parallel cracks of S/sub 0/ width each, divided by strip conductor. It is necessary to define scattering field. The decision of a problem will be carried out using the method of integral equations. Initial integral equations are decided numerically using Krylov-Bogolyubov method. As a result of integral equations an aperture of a crack is defined which is used for finding the angular radiation pattern. Patterns of the slot were calculated for different geometry parameters, space parameters and /spl phi/.

abstract: A comparative analysis of the near electric field generated by a three-dipole irradiator in a relatively dense dissipative dielectric medium such as fat or muscle tissues is performed. It is shown that the application of the three-dipole irradiator may widen the area of comparatively uniform heating, It is shown that the microwave irradiator with a quadrature feed, when one dipole is an active reflector, has a high directionality in a dense dissipative medium.

articleTitle: Plasma-chemical reactor with low ion energy for selective etching
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The results of physical and technological tests of the modernized plasma-chemical reactor are presented. The chemically active ion's energy may be controlled by the magnetic field intensity in the range from 15 eV to 100 eV. (If it is necessary the ion energy may be increased up to 300 eV). The current density is /spl les/l5 mA/cm/sup -2/. The samples for etching are attached to the top side of the three-edged prism that is an active reactor electrode. The side site is 110/spl times/130 sg mm. High stability and repeatability of its physical parameters characterize the reactor. A number of experiments have corroborated the selective etching of Si/sub 3/N/sub 4/ with respect to SiO/sub 2/, PSG with respect to Al etc. Different kinds of material such as silicon, polysilicon, titanium nitride, titanium, tungsten and molybdenum silicides are easily etched. The etching selectivity may be varied in a wide range by the gas nature, current density and ion energy variation. In fact the selective removing was realized on the layers having element size /spl plusmn/0.35 microns and the bottom metal interconnection layers were discovered. The dry and wet etching alternation assures a suitable surface quality of an analyzed layer even after a number (up to 20) top layers of multi-layer structure were removed.

articleTitle: The designing of shapers of electromagnetic fields for microwave technological plants on the basis of probability criteria
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The purpose of this research is the development of approaches allowing one to design shapers of electromagnetic fields according to the demanded modes of handling. In most cases it is impossible to precisely calculate the distributions of electromagnetic field within operating chambers with the given type and parameters of stimulating devices. To describe the allocation of intensity of electromagnetic field the application of probability approach is proposed. The proposed probability approach can be utilized for designing the shapers of electromagnetic fields in two ways, First for the estimation of the expected quality of a plant considering the nonuniformity of allocation of electromagnetic field. Second, for solving different problems of excitation device optimization. The approach also admits a series of generalizations, allowing the probability-based description of more composite handling mode versions taking the time factor into consideration.

abstract: The results of designing of an L-band synthesizer for C-band satcom stations are presented. The synthesizers allows the setting of the frequency band 760-860 MHz with 100 kHz spacing. articleTitle: Thermal stable microwave dielectrics

abstract: Thermally stable high dielectric constant ceramics are used in microwave technology as dielectric resonators, filters, microwave substrates, waveguides and antennas.
