articleTitle: Microwave FET amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The results of the development of microwave FET amplifiers are presented. The narrowband low-noise amplifiers have demonstrated the noise figure of 0.8-1.8 dB at gain of 15-30 IB over 15% bandwidth in the frequency range of 0.4-18.0 GHz. The ultrabroadband low-noise amplifiers have achieved the noise figure of 5.0-7.5 dB at gain of 25.0-33.0 dB in the frequency range of 2.0-22.0 GHz. The narrowband medium power amplifiers have demonstrated gain of 18.0-36.0 dB at the noise figure of 8.0 dB with output power of 80.0-100 mW in line mode over 10% bandwidth in the frequency range of 28.0-40.0 GHz.

articleTitle: On focusing of the infrared radiation by reflector antennas in the millimeter range
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The fields for application of millimetre-wave engineering, which require the avoidance of infrared radiation focusing, are considered. The mechanism of radiation focusing by reflector antennas is analysed.

articleTitle: The high-orbit magnetron with side cathode
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The model of the high-orbit magnetron with side cathode is proposed. First estimations show that the design is prospective for introducing into short-wave bands.

articleTitle: The automated near field measurement system for 8 mm band high directivity antennas tuning
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The description of the automated system for near field measurement on a plane aperture up to 600*6000 mm/sup 2/ is represented. The system allows restoring a far field pattern up to -30 dB. The special attention is paid to the application of the system for "Baltica" sea port radar antennas tuning (10 sets are already customized). Antennas description, tuning procedures, examples of measured near-field distributions and restored far field patterns are presented.

articleTitle: Modelling of light propagation through the dielectric particle using microwaves
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The investigation of light propagation through stretched dielectric particles with different cross section and absorption was made using the microwave modelling method.

articleTitle: Homodyne transceivers with signal modulation
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The circuit analysis of homodyne transceivers with frequency, phase and pulse modulation offers the means to enlarge the potential of radar and to determine the sign a Doppler frequency.

articleTitle: Frequency shift mixer on Gunn diode with cathode static domain
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: This paper considers the possibility of effective design of frequency shift mixers (FSM), based on Gunn diodes with non-uniform electron distribution in the cathode. The electron transition frequency is 2-3 times lower than that of the input signal. One of the main merits of the researched FSM is the possibility of carrier frequency suppression under certain values of bias voltage and impedance of transmission line, containing the Gunn-diode.

articleTitle: Composite material for defense against electromagnetic radiation
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The new porous composite graphite based material has been developed. It has unique physical and mechanical properties and provides the high level of protection against electromagnetic radiation.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of an open two-mirror resonator with a traveling wave focusing
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The results of mathematical modeling of an open resonance system as two confocal mirror reflectors with an aperture of the circumferential form are submitted. The excitation implements the conformal phased antenna arrays allocated on one of mirrors and forming a quasiplane wave propagated in the direction of other mirror. The reflected spherical wave is focused in the center of the resonator and forms the unidirectional electromagnetic field burst. The resonator is intended for the creation and investigation of artificial plasmoids. The examples of mathematical modeling of resonant process are submitted. The selection of resonator optimal geometry is considered.

articleTitle: Microwave devices simulator "Microwave Office 2000"
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Microwave Office is a completely new software for RF/microwave design aimed for operation in Windows 95 and NT. The software includes: VoltaireXL linear and nonlinear circuit simulator and the EMSight full-wave, three-dimensional electromagnetic (EM) simulator. The entire design solution is constructed using advanced object-oriented programming methods that result in impressive performance, reliability and ease of use.

articleTitle: Selection of wave range for non-geostationary satellite component of emergency and rescue services communication system
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The technical characteristics of non-geostationary-satellite system of communication intended for increasing of reliability of the short messages delivery in interests of saving human life, are presented.

articleTitle: Investigation of influence of dielectric on the electric characteristics of dual-reflector omnidirectional antenna
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: A new mathematical model of dual-reflector omnidirectional antennas, that allows simulating the influence of various cylindrical dielectric insertions on the electric characteristics, has previously been developed. In this paper, a dual-reflector omnidirectional antenna with parabolic sub-reflector, conic main reflector and TM01 mode feed (operating frequencies 27.5-29.5 GHz) illustrates the selection of an optimal dielectric insertion. This is of great importance when designing a dual-reflector omnidirectional antenna for millimeter wave applications.

articleTitle: Research of amplitude-frequency responses and Q-factors of monolithic compact ceramic filters
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The researches of amplitude-frequency responses and Q-factors of resonators, which are the part of monolithic compact ceramic filters on the basis of ceramics TBNS /spl epsiv//sub q/=80 and ALTK /spl epsiv//sub q/=37, are presented.

articleTitle: Mobile set for ecological radio monitoring
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Broad use of radio objects of different applications in municipal infrastructure causes the problem of ecological radio monitoring. This paper presents the results of development of a radio monitoring mobile set based on usage of home devices. The mobile set fulfils the following functions: the choice of observation channels using the locality maps; motion to the point of observation and control; measuring of electromagnetic fields and comparison of their values with hazard levels; detection and identification of sources of dangerous radio-frequency radiation; shaping of data base; generation of the integrated information about levels and sources of radiation. The set is implemented in two versions: portable and automobile-carried. The first one is used when it is impossible to get to the place of measurement on a car. The second one is used in a nominal mode, when the circumstances allow yielding measuring from automobiles.

articleTitle: Effect of microwave radiation on the GaAs MESFET parameters
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: We present the results of our investigations of the microwave radiation effect on the degradation processes in gallium arsenide MESFETs. It was shown that short-term action of magnetron microwave radiation (frequency of 2.45 GHz, output power of 800 W) impairs the parameters of MESFETs with a Au/Ti/n-GaAs Schottky gate. In this case the main changes occur in the Schottky gate. Replacement of titanium with TiN/sub x/ results in an increase of the Schottky barrier stability to microwave radiation.

articleTitle: Semiconductor planar resistors for ICs
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: This work presents the results of the 4-18 GHz GaAs ICs planar resistors design and fabrication. It was shown that the contact resistance may be essential in the total resistor value. The calculation method, which has a good agreement with experimental data, is proposed.

articleTitle: Broadband (0.1-12 GHz) fiber-optical photoelectric detector with low level of reflected signal for high-speed digital and analog microwave systems of information transfer
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: This paper presents experimental results of original design of ultrahigh frequency fiber optic InGaAs/InP photodetector for 0.95-1.7 mkm spectral region with high return optical loss. Reflected light in fiber optic link (caused by fiber optic connectors and receiver end-fiber cleaved end, photodiode chip surfaces) can produce output power fluctuation, phase noise, pulse distortion of laser transmitter. Optical discontinuities lead to occurrence of additional optical resonator in fiber optic transmission line and parasitic amplitude modulation of transmitted signal, which decreases S/N or RIN volume. The photo-detector demonstrates return loss as high as 50-55 dB in the wide band (0.1-12 GHz).

articleTitle: The analysis of multilayered microstrip array using method of generalized scattering matrix
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: A mathematical model of a multilayered microstrip array is presented. The analysis is carried out using the theory of generalized scattering matrix, (GSM). The theory of GSM is an effective means for calculation of fields scattered by multilayered microstrip arrays used as frequency selective surfaces, polarizers, radomes.

articleTitle: Examination of the heat and electrical modes of the M-112 magnetron operation within the plasma unit
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Results of examination of the plasma load influence on the heat operation mode of the continuous action magnetron with the air-cooling system and on the anode current curve shape, are submitted. The obtained results can be used for design of systems for microwave plasma equipment control and protection, as well as for development of protective-switch-off devices of microwave power sources. It is determined that during operation with the plasma load in the modes, acceptable for materials plasma treatment, the magnetron body temperature may exceed the specification parameters. This is caused by reflection of microwave power from the load. The magnetron body overheating is in the direct proportion to the value of microwave power, reflected from the load. Correlation between the distortion degree of the anode current signal shape and the microwave power-cum-load reflected values is determined. In order to ensure the safe operational modes of the microwave power sources within the plasma technological equipment, it is expedient to envisage the protective-switch-off devices, based on monitoring of magnetron operation heat modes and analysis of anode current curve shape.

articleTitle: TWT on the base of coaxial corrugated waveguide
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The optimisation of regular and irregular TWTs for efficiency when no backward radiation exists in the input, has been carried out on the basis of the general theory of excitation. In a TWT with regular corrugation the possible efficiency reaches 25%, while in a TWT with the optimized corrugation profile the efficiency is between 40-70%.

articleTitle: Filter based on cascaded two-pole sections formed by microstrip resonators with stubs
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Two-pole micro-strip sections based on resonators with rejecting stubs are investigated. Filter obtained using cascade connection of such sections has an increased selectivity.

articleTitle: The measurement of parameters of a helical slow-wave structure in the short circuit mode
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: A method of measurement of electrodynamic parameters of a helical slow-wave structure and a helical resonator in the mode involving short circuit of their ends is presented.

articleTitle: Low intermodulation RF amplifiers for MMDS applications
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Summary form only given. An amplifier where the third order IM distortion has been reduced is proposed, If two signals at different carrier frequencies are incident at the input of an amplifier, due to the nonlinearity, these signals will interact with each other and the output will contain additional signals at all combinations of sum and difference of these frequencies, which are IM products. The injection of the second harmonics of the two inputs in the amplifier together with the fundamental signals will produce additional IM products at the output. By proper selection of phase and amplitude of the injected second harmonics, it is possible to make the third order IM products produced by the second harmonics and the original third order IM products out of phase and equal in amplitude. As a result third order IM products will be eliminated, in principle. The output spectrum of the RF power amplifier is given.

articleTitle: The review of commercial solid-state microwave CAD software
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: In the present review the common structure of solid-state microwave CAD software is given. The basic performances and capabilities of commercial programs are surveyed. Their accomplishments and limitations are discussed.

articleTitle: Adjustable magnetorheologic gradient lenses
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Elaboration results of adjustable magnetorheologic gradient lenses based on Y/sub 3/Fe/sub 5/O/sub 12/ powder are presented. Magnetorheologic lenses permit to change its focus radius by means of magnetic field.

articleTitle: Investigation of spurious oscillations and harmonics level in beam-plasma amplifier
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The measuring apparatus of spurious oscillations in the region of the 2nd and the 3rd harmonics and experimental results made on a plasma filled TWT are presented.

articleTitle: Design and experimental research of series-fed microstrip cosecant beam arrays
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The results of calculation and experimental research of microstrip antenna arrays at 30 GHz are presented. The technique for calculation and design of traveling and standing wave modes of such arrays for linear and circular polarized radiation is given. The results of topology calculations for the various shaped patterns and different levels of losses in a material of a microstrip line are given. The experimental research of the antenna arrays (nearfield measurements and multi-frequency measurements in a far-field zone) verifies the presented method of design.

articleTitle: Signal processing in adaptive antenna arrays (AAA)
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The problem of robust adaptive generation of a polar pattern in conditions of indeterminate arrival angle and distorted front of information signal is solved. The expressions for calculation of the optimal vector of weighting coefficients for an adaptive antenna array (AAA) have been obtained.

articleTitle: Axial non-uniform waves generation by cylindrical layer of electrons rotating in the cavity
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Axial non-uniform electromagnetic waves generation by electrons, rotating in crossed fields in the free space (in the absence of the resonator) is investigated theoretically. It is shown that under sufficiently high value of radial electrostatic field, the generated wave increment grows with increasing frequency.

articleTitle: Frequency-independent antenna concepts for the use in vehicles
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: This paper presents two different types of spiral antennas, which are suitable for the integration into vehicles. The antennas have to cover radio services such as communication, navigation and broadcasting services from 470 MHz up to over 2.3 GHz. One antenna concept is based on realizing the antenna as an on-glass antenna. As the antenna has to be completely planar, a special external feeding technique is necessary. The second concept is based on placing the antenna on the car's conducting bodywork. A cavity optimizes the radiation pattern and suppresses backradiation into the vehicle's interior. The performances of both antennas are discussed.

articleTitle: Compact microwave band-pass filters
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: We have processed dielectric resonator filters in 7.5-8.7 GHz and 3.4-3.9 GHz ranges, which are applied in radio-relay stations for frequency division. Filters are realised on the base of high Q factor ceramics ALTK and TBNS. Electric parameters of filters provide the possibility to configure stations with any trunk structure. This paper describes the structure and shows electric parameters of band-pass filters.

articleTitle: The oscillations field tuning at the dielectric quarter-sphere
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: New results of the investigation of spectral characteristics and field distributions of the whispering gallery modes which are excited at the quarter-spherical dielectric resonator by the coupling slot in a metal mirror, are presented.

articleTitle: The phase-frequency method of distance measurement
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Describes a new method of radar distance measurement by means of defining the dependence of frequency on a difference in the complete phase between the radiated and the received signals (phase-frequency response-PFR). For the measurement of PFR a system of automatic frequency control (AFC) of the transmitter generator on a given phase difference of signals is used. A slope of the linear term and the period of harmonic terms in the periodic component of PFR is defined by the distances between the main reflecting object and the meter and between the main and other reflecting objects respectively.

articleTitle: A system of position-finding of a radio-frequency radiation source by means of the integral-methodology method
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: A three-position UHF system for position-finding of a radio-frequency radiation source, employing the integral-methodology method, is described. The system consist of two direction-finding and relay-measuring stations and a central measuring station with the functions of direction-finding and measuring the radio signal delay time.

articleTitle: GIS EHF on Gunn diodes
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Radiowave sensors based on planar transmission lines are widely used to design autodyne devices and systems for short-range radiolocation. The sensors are small, lightweight and cost-effective with high sensitivity. The possibilities of the sensors are especially expanded when based on modern active elements that use the GaAs structure with the interlinear transmission of the electrons (MAP diodes or diodes using the Gunn effect). As the resonance system, slot and coplanar transmission lines are used. The autodyne modules M55314 ("Tigel-5") and "Tigel-8" are made on short sections of slot transmission lines. In the 5 mm range the frequency (55-63 GHz) is fixed and in the 8 mm (33.4-36.0 GHz) range the frequency is modulated in the chain by a varactor in an interval less than +200 MHz from the carrier frequency. The design of the above-mentioned sensors with the high mechanical durability (shocks and vibration) is connected with the design of military (small-size radio-exploders, self-directing heads, etc.) as well as civil equipment (transport electronics, microwave radiography, control and measuring equipment, medicine etc.). Equipment made with the use of the given construction provide the following working modes: autodyne frequency transformation, autogeneration mode with AM modulation; multiplication of generation frequency, and autogeneration with changing frequency. The obtained results of the tests as well as the ease of construction, cost-effectiveness, high security and low cost of the proposed autodyne modules should allow their wide use.

articleTitle: The experimental temperature dependency of characteristics of MM-wave GaAs-harmonic sources
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The output watt-frequency properties of 8 mm GaAs-Gunn oscillators, operating on the 1st or 2nd harmonic are experimentally investigated. It has been shown that with environment temperature increasing (20/spl deg/C-70/spl deg/C) the oscillator frequency band is narrowed by 15% to 30%.

articleTitle: Multi-mode wake-field excitation by sequence of relativistic electron bunches in dielectric waveguide
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Wake-fields, which are excited in a dielectric waveguide by relativistic electron bunches can be used in perspective accelerators of charged particles and in powerful HF generators. In the case of excitation of wake-fields by a regular sequence of bunches the fields of separate bunches superpose coherently. For large values of dielectric permittivity /spl epsi/E, due to multi-mode operation wake-field represents a sequence of soliton-like spikes of alternative signs with much higher amplitude in comparison with one principle mode excitation. In this work we take into account 50 harmonics.

articleTitle: Scattering coefficients for radiation from an open-ended circular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The waveguide radiator scattering coefficients have been analyzed and computed on the basis of an accurate solution of the diffraction problem for an open-ended circular waveguide excited by TE/sub 11/ dominant mode and symmetrical TE/sub 01/ and TM/sub 01/ modes.

articleTitle: Optimizing gain of finite size corner-reflector antenna
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Using the GTD method, the author has calculated the dependencies of maximum gains of the 90/spl deg/ corner antenna, excited by a half-wave dipole on its position within the corner, when changing widths and heights of the corner from 0.5/spl lambda/ to 6/spl lambda/. The optimal corner sizes providing maximum gains at each dipole position were determined. The efficient algorithm allows one to carry out the corresponding analysis of the gain for the corner with an arbitrary apex angle.

articleTitle: Method for calculation of channels transmission capacity in ATM networks and various entering services
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: A method for calculation of ATM channels throughput for message transfer submitted in formats of other technologies, in particular: frame relay, B-ISDN for the telephone messages, and videoflow MPEG-2, is offered.

articleTitle: Modern transceiver for data transfer in the narrowband systems of the technology communications
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The modern transceiver with built-in diagnostics allows the creation a floppy data transfer system that may be applied widely in industrial systems. A high-speed modem decreases the traffic load, increases transferred data volume and makes controlled objects more informative.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of classical and new transmission lines for telecommunication systems
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Comparative analysis results of the main features of classical and new types of transmission lines for different telecommunication MM-wave applications, have been presented. New lines are based on flat waveguide splitters both with (EH, HE odd and even modes) and without (E odd modes only) dielectric filling. The main advantages of the new lines for practical utilization, have been shown.

articleTitle: A method for automatic extraction of MESFET linear model parameters
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Presents the results of development of a measuring set for quickly obtaining an FET linear model. S-parameters are measured by HP8720D circuit analyzer. The device control and mathematical processing is carried out automatically using a PC. The measurement results and parameters of transistor model of 311612A-5 type, which have been obtained using the proposed set, are given.

articleTitle: Selective properties of two-pole section based on irregular microstrip resonators
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: In quasi-static approximation the frequency-dependent factor of coupling of two identical parallel microstrip resonators with a step of strip width is obtained.

articleTitle: Controlled microwave delay line on ferroelectric capacitors
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The report presents the results of development and investigation of controlled microwave delay lines based on ferro-electric capacitors. The delay lines can be used at the large signal levels in a path. They have small levels of signal distortion.

articleTitle: Microwave resonator transducers for moisture measuring
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: For defining the moisture content it is proposed to use the combined parameters of a microwave resonator aperture transducer, independent of the hindering factors. The electrodynamics calculation has been carried out with the use of the partial domain method. The results of experimental research are presented.

articleTitle: Microwave diagnostics of basins ecological state
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The report presents the results of studying ground sediments and soil samples by means of electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) method. The report also shows the prospects of using microwave diagnostics together with the specially developed method of organic and mineral pollution concentration for monitoring the ecological state of natural basins.

articleTitle: Simulation of a two-diode microwave limiter
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The power-limiting characteristics for a single-diode limiter and a two-diode module have been investigated using the numerical modeling software ISTOC based on the fundamental semiconductor equation system. A PIN-diode having a 5 /spl mu/m basewidth is shown to operate successfully as a passive limiter at frequencies up to 2 GHz providing an isolation of about 20 dB. At higher frequencies its operation is severely degraded because of the transit-time effect. A new version of a two-diode quasi-active limiter module is shown to be an attractive alternative to conventional solid-state limiter devices. The optimal value for the Schottky-barrier diode capacitance is found. An isolation of 11.5 dB has been demonstrated for the 1.5 cm range. The utilized modeling technique enables analyzing multi-element microwave devices with a complicated interaction between the components in stationary and dynamic regimes. It provides also an effective means for the optimization of device properties.

articleTitle: Efficiency of broadband and narrowband radiating high power systems
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: High power systems of broadband and narrowband radiation are considered, Their efficiency is evaluated with respect to radiation propagation through space.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic coupling of high power radiation with electronic circuits
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The electromagnetic interference appearing in electronic circuits due to the coupling of high-power radio frequency radiation has been considered. Rectification processes in nonlinear elements have been taken into account. The results of theoretical calculation, computer simulation and experimental investigation are presented.

articleTitle: Selection of Z-antenna geometry parameters and evaluation of their frequency properties
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The analysis of radiation characteristics for a zigzag antenna is presented. On the basis of the obtained expressions, the geometric parameters for zigzag antennas were chosen and for the vector field components the analysis of frequency characteristics is made under the condition that the wave slowing down along the radiation wire is not great (/spl xi//spl equiv/1.0).

articleTitle: Features of information safety maintenance in communications systems
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: An effective technology of protection of information resources of departmental communications systems, including their automated management system, and also information resources of all distributed automated office systems, is offered. The features of safety maintenance of connection of a departmental telecommunication network, including satellite communication channels using ABCS technology and star-shaped satellite network with earth satellite stations PES and SCPC, are presented.

articleTitle: The optimization of efficiency of relativistic TWT with irregular corrugated waveguide taking into account the harmonics of a signal
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Self-consistent non-linear one dimensional equations of relativistic TWT-O with slowing system in the form of arbitrary irregular waveguide taking into account the arbitrary number of signal harmonics and average forces of electron interaction, are formulated. The influence of the second harmonic of signal in TWT-O, optimized by efficiency, is estimated. Their frequency band performance is investigated.

articleTitle: The genetic concept of topological synthesis of waveguide polarizator with elliptical factor 0.95 for antennas of satellite communication of a C-band 3.7/6.5 GHz
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The results of development of small-sized waveguide polarizator for tracts of mirror antennas of satellite communication operating in the C-band are submitted. Polarizator was designed using technology of topological synthesis and concept of genetic algorithm. The polarizator obtained provides transformation of two circular polarizations into two linear polarizations in bandwidth f/sub r/=3.7-4.2 GHz and f/sub 1/=6.025-6.525 GHz at reception and transfer, accordingly, with elliptical factor K/sub e/=0.95. Polarizator consists of three devices made with the use of milling machine with program control. It has no elements of adjustment.

articleTitle: The influence of electromagnetic radiation of millimeter and centimeter range on human epithelial cells
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The influence of electromagnetic fields of wavelengths of 7.1 mm and 1.6 cm on human buccal epithelium cells was investigated. The low-level irradiation (200 /spl mu/W/cm/sup 2/) of cell samples induced an increase in cell membrane permeability and the decrease in electronegativity of cell nuclei.

articleTitle: An optimizing of dynamic range of light current video amplifier for fiber-optic coupling
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The considered method of analysis of dynamic characteristics of amplifying microwave devices on MESFETs allows to receive numerical meanings of dynamic range and to optimize this parameter, without resorting to prototyping. Developed on the basis of the complete equivalent circuit PSpice, the model MESFET can be used for the analysis of a wide class of microwave devices.

articleTitle: Theory of the MM wave hybrid electron devices
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The results of research on the electronic-wave interaction efficiency in the O-type hybrid device of millimeter and submillimeter waves are presented. The amplifier scheme with nonresonance partitioned output stage is considered, in which the slow-wave system can be allocated on different sides of the planar electrodynamic structure. Results of the gain and efficiency calculations are presented on the basis of the combined nonlinear two-dimensional theory of a hybrid amplifier.

articleTitle: Some features of electromagnetic field strength measuring by bead-pull method
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: In this paper described are the methods for estimation of the field strength measurement accuracy in multi-cavity resonant systems with weak coupling using small perturbation technique as well as corresponding equipment for such measurements.

articleTitle: The technique of microwave multiport transducer calibration
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Technique of calibration of the multiport microwave transducer, which is intended for an automatic network analyzer, is described. The mathematical model for a multi-port transducer is represented. Expressions for determination of equivalent complex parameters of the transducer are derived.

articleTitle: About optimization of multiple conical antenna geometry
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: Numerical research of directional and polarization properties of multiple conical spiral antennas is carried out in the present work. Here, antenna radiation operation areas are obtained with dependence on the radiator geometry, and potential possibilities of forming the required radiation characteristics are estimated. In the literature, the analysis of radiation characteristics is given for the single-mode approximation. On the one hand it limits the range of geometry variation, but on the other hand it allows research into the operation area of antenna axial radiation. Therefore, to calculate the antenna radiation field, we used the vector-potential method that allowed the analysis of the radiation characteristics of the antenna with a given geometry. The antenna geometrical parameters to be optimized are the initial radius of spiral active area; the number of turns; the spiral pitch and the angle. According to the presented analysis of electromagnetic properties of the equipitch conical spiral antenna, we can choose the antenna geometry and estimate its influence on the directional and polarization properties.

articleTitle: Research of radiation field shaping singularities for multibeam reflector antenna
publicationTitle: 2000 10th International Crimean Microwave Conference. "Microwave and Telecommunication Technology". Conference Proceedings (IEEE Cat. No.00EX415)
abstract: The last decade was characterised by the rapid development of satellite communication and broadcasting systems all over the world. It has caused the introduction of systems with frequency reuse and systems whose channel separation is based upon space selection, into the field of antenna technology. The development of such antennas and research of singularities of their radiation performances shaping is the task which is considered in the given work.
